description: Checks one exact npm package version and its whole dependency tree for known advisories. Returns severity and fixed versions, whether this version or the whole package is deprecated, and npm's latest version. Facts only, no AI verdict. Faster and cheaper than POST_assess. If the result has a "warning", the tool had no data for that version (it may be too new for deps.dev, or may not exist): don't treat it as clean. Inputs: packageName, packageVersion (exact, e.g. 4.17.1).
